description: Go backend service owning the product catalog, shopping cart, checkout, and order data for the ceramics storefront. Exposes a REST API consumed by ceramics-webapp: catalog browse/search/admin-CRUD, per-shopper cart management, checkout (stock validation, payment charge via the payment provider, order creation, stock decrement), and order history. Persists all data in an embedded-schema relational database (postgres platform resource) keyed by owning-shopper id where applicable. Does not render any UI and does not issue its own auth tokens.
